season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep kept. Logged summits: Aug 8, Sep 3, Jul 1, Oct 2. Web search: one mirror of the encyclopedia entry gives June-September, the neighbouring Noyes guide gives June-August; no guidebook-level source found that overrides the stored window.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 29 2026, summited, in season, via Seattle Basin / Noyes-Seattle col to Noyes-Meany col and the south ridge, but the GPX starts part-way along the Skyline trail (about 17 km from our trailhead pin) on a 43-mile overnight; not a complete round trip from a trailhead.
Sep 12 2020, summited, same col route, but the track starts at a mid-route trail point (about 17 km from the pin), 12 mi round trip from there; not a complete trailhead round trip.

facts.text: From late August into September, parties leave the Skyline Trail near 4,800 ft, cross a flat dry-tarn plateau around 4,900 ft, then sidehill to the Noyes-Seattle col; in cloud it is easy to aim for the wrong col.
The scree traverse from the Noyes-Seattle col across to the Noyes-Meany col is steep, hard-packed and slippery, with several gullies; it is the worst footing of the trip.

notes: No qualifying track: both summit tracks start mid-trail rather than at the North Fork Quinault trailhead.
